what: Table 3 (F32-F34): the honest-twin fixtures with gen3's REAL declaration path (admin create_org + member-add orgs.jsonl rows + repo-scoped access-200), at gen2's pre-warm-up placement (T0 = day 5.787), plus the G4 just-minted declared lab, scored by H7, A, B AND C3 (no-warm-up and 7-day-warm-up). Full p_same x condition grid from ONE results file. No model calls.
groups: G1 team_divider (fresh, UNDECLARED, dividing teamdiv); G2 approved_lab (aged, DECLARED, dividing radiant) [control]; G3 cohort7 (fresh, undeclared, OVERLAP vocalis) [control]; G4 newlab (fresh, DECLARED via real org rows, dividing evalhold in-envelope). Each cell entry lists which groups the detector flags/challenges.

grid.note: G2 (approved_lab) is cleared/exempt by every detector in every cell (aged -> no co-registration for H7/A/B; declared in-envelope -> exempt for C3), so it is omitted from the cells below. C3_7dwarmup is 0 (empty) in EVERY cell because the fixtures sit at day 5.8 < the 7-day warm-up -> confirmed, see confirms.

by_group.G1_undeclared_divider: challenged/paged when it divides disjointly (low p_same). C3 catches it in burst AND spread (0.0, 0.2); A catches burst (0.0,0.2) + spread (0.0,0.2); H7 catches burst only (0.0,0.2); B flags it at ALL p_same in burst (convergence ignores partition/overlap). At high p_same (0.5,0.8) the partition detectors (H7/A/C3) clear it (P>=1.6) but B still flags it.
by_group.G4_just_minted_declared_lab: FALSE-PAGED by H7, A and B in burst at EVERY p_same (0.0-0.8), because G4 is a fixed disjoint divider and these detectors ignore declaration (H7, B) or count only the admin's request_access (A -> declared_frac 0.12). EXEMPT by C3 in every cell (orgs.jsonl membership -> declared_frac 1.0). In spread, H7/B clear G4 (no burst) and A clears it (first-pulls split into 3600-s windows of <5).
by_group.G3_overlap_cohort: flagged ONLY by B (convergence), at every p_same in burst; cleared by the partition detectors (H7/A/C3) because it overlaps (high P). Cleared by all in spread.
by_group.G2_approved_lab: cleared/exempt by every detector in every cell (aged + declared in-envelope).

key_findings: With REAL declaration records, C3 is the ONLY detector that EXEMPTS the just-minted declared lab G4; H7 and B ignore declaration and A counts only the admin's request_access (declared_frac 0.12), so all three false-page it in burst. This REVERSES the earlier read that 'A exempted the declared lab' -- that was the gen2 artefact (member-level requests the hub refuses, no orgs.jsonl rows).

C3 and A catch the UNDECLARED divider in spread where H7 and B need the tight sign-up burst; B over-flags (it flags the overlap cohort G3 and the divider at every p_same, because it keys on convergence not partition).

SHAM-ORG HOLE (concrete): C3 exempts G4 because it declared in-envelope -> a sham that declares enough seats passes C3 identically. The fix is provenance (declared AND standing), not declaration alone.
C3's 7-day warm-up zeroes every cell here only because the fixtures sit at day 5.8; the post-warm-up behaviour (C3 challenges the divider) is results/twin_postwarmup.json (F71).

confirms_for_5_5.spread_A_clears_G4: YES. G4's 8 first-pulls in spread span 5476 s and split into greedy 3600-s windows of sizes [4, 4] -- below A's k=5 floor. (G1's 10 accounts still form a >=5 window, n=7, so A pages G1.)
confirms_for_5_5.C3_warmup_zero: YES. C3-with-7-day-warm-up is 0 in every cell only because the fixtures are at day 5.8 < 7; the warm-up exempts them. F71 has the post-warm-up behaviour.

caveat: Synthetic minimal-world fixtures (rng seed 42), n=1 per cell; declared controls carry real orgs.jsonl rows; G1/G4 each divide a repo of their own (no concurrent honest first-pullers dilute P).
